notes.title: SUGAMENIA Update 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Hello, adventurers of SUGAMENIA!

We’re excited to announce that Update 1.1.0 is now live, bringing a host of new content! Get ready to explore a new and dangerous area, face new enemies, and solve challenging puzzles that will test your skills. It’s time to dive back into SUGAMENIA and experience everything this update has to offer!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902861/4bd8445baa6cc14bcc5dff60a4e80b9506e410ef.png

What’s New in Update 1.1.0:

New Area: The Temple of Contamination:


 Venture into the Temple of Contamination, a unique area that blends the grandeur of an ancient temple with the presence of mysterious advanced technology.
 The atmosphere in this place is filled with toxic gases that block your path and threaten Violet’s health. Fortunately, Suichi can block the gas outlets to clear the air, allowing Violet to safely move forward and reach previously inaccessible areas.
 Explore hidden passages, unlock secret chambers, and discover how ancient structures intertwine with modern technology.


New Enemies:


 The temple’s guardians have been corrupted by the toxicity. Face new foes such as technological drones and ancient constructs, each of which will test your combat skills.
 Every enemy has unique attack patterns and becomes stronger in areas with a high concentration of toxic gas, making each battle more intense and strategic.


New Challenging Puzzles:


 Solve intricate puzzles that utilize new environmental mechanics: use Suichi to clear gases, move technological platforms, block gas outlets, and activate ancient mechanisms.
 Make use of Suichi’s abilities to bypass traps and discover hidden treasures that will help you upgrade your equipment and skills.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902861/0ed76a0534345e637fc3c616a8d5c759c5776a26.png

Explore the Temple of Contamination Today!

Update SUGAMENIA now and dive into this new and thrilling area. Use Suichi to clear the toxic environment, block gas outlets, unlock hidden paths, and face the dangers lurking within the Temple of Contamination!

As always, we appreciate your feedback and suggestions. Don’t hesitate to share your experience with us on the community forums!

Thank you for being part of the adventure in SUGAMENIA!

notes.title: SUGAMENIA Update 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Hello, SUGAMENIA community!

We’re excited to announce that Update 1.0.4 is now live. This update introduces a new Hard Mode for those seeking a greater challenge, along with significant improvements to text, UI, and more. Here are all the details:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902861/2b55704e653b892bbd8a3af65c27135af57e2641.png

What’s New in Update 1.0.4

New Hard Mode

You can now face tougher enemies with fewer aids in the new Hard Mode, designed to push your skills to the limit.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902861/0a894435b1fdd7f4dc1cf8cacc258a14c6e1ce0d.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902861/409f56d62e89e5d317251e59684955322cde535c.png

Text and Localization Improvements

We’ve revised and improved text in all available languages to ensure greater clarity and consistency.
Localization enhancements have been made to provide a more immersive experience across all languages.

User Interface (UI) Updates

We’ve made adjustments to the UI to make it more intuitive and easier to navigate.

Check Out the New Features in Update 1.0.4 Today!

Update your game now and enjoy the new features and improvements SUGAMENIA has to offer. As always, we appreciate your feedback, so feel free to share your experience in the forums.

Thank you for being part of the SUGAMENIA adventure!
